remarks:
Welcome Home! Discover the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and convenience in this beautiful four-bedroom home! The first floor features two bedrooms, including a smaller room that offers the perfect opportunity for a home office or flexible living space. The inviting kitchen flows into a bright and charming morning room, where you can relax with your morning coffee while taking in the peaceful views of the backyard and Tonawanda Creek.

Love the outdoors? This backyard offers a wonderful setting for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying your favorite outdoor activities. Step inside from the patio through the morning room and into the spacious first-floor living area, creating an easy flow for everyday living and gatherings.

Upstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms separated by a cozy gathering area, perfect for a reading nook, sitting space, or additional lounge area. The clean basement provides a dedicated laundry area along with plenty of room for storage.

Conveniently located near Transit Road, you’ll enjoy easy access to shopping, dining, and everyday essentials while still having the opportunity to unwind in your own peaceful backyard retreat
